headline: In Lomé, CIMA undertakes revision of its founding treaty after more than 30 years
summary: A committee of experts has started work in Lomé on revising the treaty that governs insurance markets in the 14 CIMA member states. The 1992 framework is being adapted to technological, economic and financial changes.
why: CIMA, the Inter-African Conference of Insurance Markets, sets the common legal framework for insurers across 14 francophone African states. Changes affect insurance regulation and capital requirements in the region.
original_headline: A Lomé, la CIMA engage la révision de son traité fondateur après plus de 30 ans
